messages:
Gia (People Ops): Quick operational note for the mid‑year review: we've moved up the manager summary deadline by 3 days to help with compressed calibration windows. New dates in the cycle doc: self‑eval close 2026-06-14, manager summaries 2026-06-18, calibration 2026-06-22->06-24, locks 2026-06-26. Please flag blockers ASAP.

Tom (People Ops): Two new admin changes this cycle: 1) managers must upload anonymized evidence bullets (max 3) with each summary, and 2) a mandatory 1:1 script to use within 3 business days post‑ratings. Links in doc.

Nora (Eng Manager): Heads-up: a couple of my directs are on overlapping interview loops. Does that change the timing for when offers/comp decisions happen relative to ratings?

RecruitBot: Automated note: Recruiting & People Ops coordinate on comp timing. For candidates with pending offers during the calibration window, Recruiting will hold final comp discussions until ratings lock to avoid over‑commitment. DM @recruiting for case-specifics.

Eli (IC): Small question: is peer feedback back this cycle? I liked the short 3‑prompt flow last time.

Gia (People Ops): Yes — optional peer feedback is available for ICs with significant cross‑team work. It's anonymized and aggregated. Use the auto-suggest reviewer list to save time. Peer window dates are in the doc.

Nora (Eng Manager): For timezone-limited teams (APAC), what's the async option? I have two people who won't be online during panels.

Tom (People Ops): Async workflow: mark the case "async" in the RSVP sheet, upload manager pre‑reads and a 3‑minute voice memo summary. Panel lead will review and add rationale notes. We also reserve 30-minute late‑slot panels where needed.

Eli (IC): If my manager misses the 1:1 window, what's the fallback? I want to ensure feedback isn't lost while I'm traveling.

Gia (People Ops): Managers must complete the 1:1 within 3 business days; if not possible, they should record a short memo and schedule within 5 business days. If neither happens, escalate to People Ops and we'll coordinate.

Nora (Eng Manager): Can People Ops paste a one‑liner I can drop into invites for panelists? Cuts down on back-and-forth.

Tom (People Ops): Paste this: "Please review anonymized pre‑reads before the calibration meeting. Bring 2 succinct talking points per review (impact, development). We'll timebox to 12 minutes per person. Anchors: https://go/redwood/perf-midyear-2026"

RecruitBot: Reminder: managers running hiring should coordinate comp timing with Recruiting if offers overlap the rating window. See: https://go/redwood/comp-timing.

Gia (People Ops): Final note: no comp rationale in the initial manager summary — panels assess evidence+impact. Comp work happens post‑calibration with Finance & Recruiting. If you need a temporary deferral for a direct report on leave, submit the extension form and CC People Ops. Thanks!
